defaults.basis: Preserve established canonical date, score, result, overtime, and concrete H/A/N when UNLV's frozen source conflicts with an existing reciprocal canonical value and no stronger accepted authority overturns it. The UNLV source assertion remains preserved as provenance. Where the canonical value is UNKNOWN or a clearly stronger frozen venue/event classification exists, use the explicit per-decision override below instead of this default.
defaults.identity_basis: One real game equals one canonical game. Match the reciprocal candidate supported by score/result, same-season companion-game cardinality, and reciprocal source context; do not duplicate an already represented canonical game.
defaults.not_applicable_basis: This conditional discrepancy belongs to a canonical identity candidate not selected by the recommendation map.
